mermaid:
---
title: OAuth 2 authorization code login with PKCE
---
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant B as Browser
    participant S as Our SPA
    participant A as Auth server
    participant API as Our API
    U->>B: Click "Log in"
    B->>S: Login clicked
    activate S
    Note over S: Make code_verifier, code_challenge = SHA256(verifier), state
    S->>B: Redirect to /authorize (challenge, state)
    deactivate S
    B->>A: GET /authorize?code_challenge&state
    activate A
    A-->>B: Login page
    U->>B: Enter credentials, consent
    B->>A: POST credentials
    A-->>B: 302 to redirect_uri?code&state
    deactivate A
    B->>S: Load callback with code, state
    activate S
    Note over S: Check state matches
    S->>A: POST /token (code, code_verifier)
    activate A
    Note over A: Verify SHA256(verifier) = challenge
    A-->>S: Access token, ID token, refresh token
    deactivate A
    S->>API: GET /me (Bearer access token)
    activate API
    API->>A: Fetch JWKS (cached)
    A-->>API: Signing keys
    Note over API: Validate signature, audience, expiry
    API-->>S: 200 user profile
    deactivate API
    S-->>B: Render signed-in view
    deactivate S
